title: Toward high sustainability using fully recycled geopolymer concrete: mechanical, rheological, and microstructural properties
content:

This study explores the sustainable production of fully recycled geopolymer concrete using waste ordinary Portland cement (OPC) concrete, aiming to reduce environmental impact and promote circular construction practices.
